settings.about_bio:
I enjoy the full journey of a design: understanding the product, finding the one idea worth saying, and then obsessing over type, colour and composition until it feels effortless.

My toolkit spans Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects, Figma and Blender, which lets me move comfortably between print, digital and motion.

projects.title: Kova Glide Low
projects.short_description: A launch poster for a lightweight everyday sneaker.
projects.description:
A launch poster for Kova, a fictional sneaker brand. The brief: introduce the Glide Low as the lightest shoe in the range, with a confident, sporty voice.

Oversized condensed type sits behind the product so the shoe can break out of the frame, while a lime price badge and short feature list keep the essentials easy to scan.
projects.design_process: I started with silhouette studies to get a sneaker that reads instantly at thumbnail size, then built a cobalt, lime and warm-cream palette that stays energetic without shouting.
projects.challenges: Balancing a very large headline with the product illustration — the type had to feel bold while the shoe remained the clear focal point.
projects.outcome: A poster system with a reusable layout for future colourways and seasonal drops.

projects.title: Orbit Pulse 2
projects.short_description: A calm, premium launch visual for a fitness smartwatch.
projects.description:
A product launch visual for Orbit, a fictional wearables brand. The goal was to present health features clearly while keeping the mood premium and calm.

A midnight gradient, a coral strap and thin callout lines guide the eye from the headline to the key features and the specs below.
projects.design_process: I mapped the information hierarchy first — name, promise, three features, three specs — then designed the watch face and activity rings to echo the brand colours.
projects.challenges: Showing several features without clutter. Grouped callouts and a single accent colour keep the layout readable.
projects.outcome: A launch visual that adapts easily to social posts and web banners.
